title.en: Condenser inlet tube temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Condenser inlet tube ka temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: Temperature sensor at condenser inlet tube loose, failed, or sampling abnormal (multi-split outdoor).
meaning.ur: Condenser ke inlet tube ka temperature sensor loose/kharab ya sampling abnormal hai (multi-split outdoor).

causes.ur: Sensor ki wiring dheeli hai
Sensor kharab hai
Sampling circuit theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Isolate the outdoor unit at the disconnect switch and remove the service cover before touching the sensor wiring.
solutions.ur: Sensor wiring chhoone se pehle outdoor unit ko disconnect switch se band karke service cover utaar dein.

solutions.en: Check the inlet tube sensor connector and cable for looseness or damage, reseat it, and watch whether the code clears after a power cycle.
solutions.ur: Inlet tube sensor ka connector aur cable ki tightness ya nuqs dekhein, dobara lagayein, aur power cycle ke baad code clear ho ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: If the code returns, measure the sensor resistance with a multeter and compare it with a known-good sensor; replace the inlet tube sensor if it reads out of range, otherwise technician checks the outdoor control board sampling circuit.
solutions.ur: Agar code wapas aaye to multimeter se sensor ki resistance naapein aur kisi known-good sensor se compare karein; reading range se bahar ho to inlet tube sensor badlein, warna technician outdoor control board ki sampling circuit check kare.

meaning.en: Clock IC on wired remote control board failed — change the wired remote controller.
meaning.ur: Wired remote control board par clock IC kharab — wired remote controller badal dein.

causes.ur: Wired remote ka control board theek nahi hai

causes.en: Clock IC failure on wired remote PCB (cold joint or IC fault)
causes.ur: Wired remote PCB par clock IC kharab hai (cold joint ya IC fault)

solutions.en: Reseat wired-remote connector; power-cycle to clear transient
solutions.ur: Wired-remote connector dobara lagayein; transient hatane ke liye power cycle karein

solutions.en: Replace the wire remote controller
solutions.ur: Wire remote controller ko badlein

source.title: Hisense T1 Series Floor Standing AC Service Manual V3.2 (manualslib 2199820 pp.71–92)

title.en: Wire remote controller humidity sensor failure
title.ur: Wired remote controller humidity sensor kharabi

meaning.en: Humidity/temperature sensor in wired remote failed — change the wired remote controller.
meaning.ur: Wired remote ka humidity/temperature sensor kharab — wired remote controller badal dein.

causes.ur: Wired remote ka temperature/humidity sensor theek nahi hai
Wired remote ka control board theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Power the unit off before opening the wired remote, so the small sensor inside is not damaged.
solutions.ur: Wired remote kholne se pehle unit band karein taake andar chhota sensor kharab na ho.

solutions.en: Check the wired-remote sensor connector, reseat it, and clean dust from the sensor opening; then power-cycle to clear a transient error.
solutions.ur: Wired remote sensor ka connector check karein, dobara lagayein, aur sensor ke khole ki dhool saaf karein; uske baad power cycle karke transient error hatayein.

solutions.en: If the code still shows, replace the wire remote controller, because the temperature/humidity sensor is built into it.
solutions.ur: Agar code phir bhi aaye to wire remote controller badlein, kyunki temperature/humidity sensor usi mein laga hota hai.

source.title: Hisense T1 Series Floor Standing AC Service Manual V3.2 (manualslib 2199820 pp.71–92)

title.en: Main control board to wiring remote communication fault
title.ur: Main control board aur wiring remote ke darmiyan communication fault

meaning.en: Wiring between wired remote and indoor control board loose, wrong sequence, failed, or either device failed; code shown on the wiring remote controller.
meaning.ur: Wired remote aur indoor control board ke darmiyan wiring loose, tarteeb ghalat ya kharab ho sakti hai, ya in mein se koi bhi device kharab ho; code wired remote controller par nazar aata hai.

causes.ur: Wiring dheeli hai ya sequence ghalat hai
Wiring ya wired remote kharab hai
Indoor control board theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Reconnect/replace wiring per diagram
solutions.ur: Diagram ke mutabiq wiring dobara jorein ya badlein

solutions.en: Replace wired remote controller
solutions.ur: Wired remote controller badlein

solutions.en: Replace indoor control board
solutions.ur: Indoor control board badlein

source.title: Hisense T1 Series Floor Standing AC Service Manual V3.2 (manualslib 2199820 pp.71–92)

notes.en: Arlington notes wire remote "FE" = cannot receive indoor board signals — agrees. Export family also uses FE = voltage over/under on other lines.
notes.ur: Arlington ke notes ke mutabiq wire remote "FE" ka matlab hai indoor board ke signals nahi milte — yeh baat sahi hai. Export family doosri lines par FE = voltage over/under bhi use karti hai.

title.en: Main control board to display board communication fault
title.ur: Main control board aur display board ke darmiyan communication fault

meaning.en: Displayed on the display board when main control ↔ display board communication fails (wiring loose/reversed/failed, display board or indoor control board failed).
meaning.ur: ER display board par nazar aata hai jab main control board aur display board ka rabta toot jaye (wiring loose/reversed/kharab, display board ya indoor control board kharab).

causes.en: Wiring between display board and indoor control board loose, wrong sequence, or failed
causes.ur: Display board aur indoor control board ke darmiyan wiring dheeli, ghalat sequence ya kharab hai
Display board kharab hai
Indoor control board kharab hai

solutions.en: Reconnect/replace display board wiring
solutions.ur: Display board ki wiring dobara jorein ya badlein

solutions.en: Replace display board
solutions.ur: Display board badlein

solutions.en: Replace indoor control board
solutions.ur: Indoor control board badlein
